card.name: Discard unused portion instructions
card.fires_on: The word portion(s) right after "unused" in discard instructions for leftover solution. It also fires on gram units (g) after an amount in dilution or alcohol-unit text.

modes.label: Unused portion
modes.description: The word portion or portions (or the ending of it) after "Discard unused" in preparation and storage directions.
modes.example: Infuse over 4 hours. Discard unused<< portion>>. The diluted solution is compatible with poly

modes.label: Grams after a number
modes.description: The unit g after a number when stating an amount of a substance such as iodine or alcohol.
modes.example: the suggested dilution for adults is 240 mL (88<< g>> iodine) in 1,0
